confirmation.description: Se consultarán en PuntoSeguro las cotizaciones disponibles con la fecha de nacimiento y el capital que indiques. Si aún no los has indicado, se mostrará un formulario para escribirlos. No se crea ninguna solicitud.
confirmation.title: ¿Consultar cotizaciones de seguro de vida?

description: Returns the indicative annual life-insurance protection (vida riesgo) premiums available through PuntoSeguro for a resident of Spain, given an exact date of birth and a coverage amount: insurer ids, insurer names and premiums for death, death and disability, double and triple capital, and displays the comparison interface where supported. When the date of birth or the coverage amount is missing, it returns PuntoSeguro's quote form and the list of missing details instead of quotes. Results are limited to the insurers available through PuntoSeguro and are not a whole-market comparison.
